blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A vision–language–action (VLA) policy can finish a manipulation task while knocking over objects unrelated to it, so task success alone does not show that the policy is safe to deploy in clutter. We study how to keep a pretrained VLA policy clear of such hazards at run time without retraining it, which requires guarding more of the arm than the end effector, following the hazard as it moves, and sharing onboard compute with the policy. Our training-free shield covers the gripper, wrist, and forearm with five ellipsoids and filters every commanded motion through one barrier program against a keep-out ellipsoid fitted from RGB-D perception at reset. Sparse optical flow then carries that ellipsoid’s center along with the hazard, with no repeated detection or refitting. Over six simulated hazard-motion conditions, the shield lowers collision from 65.62 % 65.62\% to 27.27 % 27.27\% and raises safe-success, task completion without collision, from 29.35 % 29.35\% to 50.43 % 50.43\% . Ablations show that guarding the arm links protects beyond end-effector shielding, and that tracking recovers most of the protection lost when the hazard estimate is frozen at reset. On heterogeneous edge hardware, the five-ellipsoid barrier runs on the CPU in 2.2 2.2 ms at the 99th percentile, and trimming the vision–language prefix and taking fewer flow-matching steps shortens each π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} policy call on the integrated GPU from 343 343 to 177.3 177.3 ms. On a physical SO-101 arm across four tasks, the arm touched the hazard in 3 of 16 shielded episodes versus 11 of 16 unshielded ones. Project page: https://yathag.github.io/multilink-safety-filter/

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Robot manipulation is shifting from task-specific controllers to general policies that follow language instructions: vision–language–action (VLA) policies act across diverse tasks and scenes [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , and multimodal large language models now command robot arms directly from camera images [ 4 ] . In shared workspaces, task completion alone is insufficient: a robot reaching for a dish may complete the task while its forearm knocks over a nearby glass. The commanded goal does not account for the cost of disturbing that unrelated object, and near sharp tools or people, the same contact can cause injury. With moving hazards, the π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 1 ] flow-matching policy completes 62.93 % 62.93\% of episodes but disturbs the hazard in 65.62 % 65.62\% of episodes. Protecting against such a hazard requires constraints that extend beyond the task objective, and those constraints must follow it as it moves.
blocks.zh: 机器人操控正在从特定任务控制器转向遵循语言指令的一般政策:视觉-语言-动作(VLA)政策跨越不同任务和场景[1,2,3],多式大型语言模型现在直接从相机图像中指挥机器人手臂[4]. 在共享的工作空间中,单是任务完成是不够的:一个机器人到达一个菜肴时可能会完成任务,而它的前臂会敲过附近的玻璃. 受命目标不计算扰动这个无关物体的成本,接近锐利的工具或人员,同样的接触会造成伤害. 在移动危险中, 0. 5\ pi\ 0. 5} [ 1] 流量匹配政策完成了 62. 93% 的 62.93% 的 事件,但在 65. 62% 的 65.62% 的 事件 中 扰动危险 。 防范这种危险需要超越任务目标的制约,这些制约必须随其发展而随之而来。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning on collision-free demonstrations can encode avoidance in a policy’s weights [ 5 ] , but it depends on demonstrations that represent the hazard. A runtime safety filter instead imposes a keep-out constraint on a hazard designated at execution time, without retraining; control-barrier filters modify the nominal command to satisfy it [ 6 , 7 ] , and existing VLA safety filters establish this interface [ 8 , 9 ] . Because the filter acts only on commanded motion, it is compatible with diverse safety-fine-tuned policies or a multimodal language model.
blocks.zh: 对无碰撞示威进行精细调整可以在政策重量[5]中编码避免,但取决于代表危险的示威。 相反,运行时安全过滤器对执行时指定的危险施加了不重复的限制;控制屏蔽过滤器修改了标称命令以满足它[6,7],而现有的VLA安全过滤器建立了这个接口[8,9]. 由于过滤器只按命令运动,它与各种安全调整政策或多式联运模式相兼容。

blocks.en: Deployment, however, requires protection across the arm links that sweep the workspace, updates to the keep-out region as it moves, and execution within a compute budget shared with the policy. Onboard execution keeps control and its protection independent of network availability and latency. These requirements are coupled: broader coverage protects only if the hazard estimate is current, and keeping it current adds computation to the control loop.
blocks.zh: 然而,部署需要在整个臂链中提供保护,这些臂链横扫工作空间,在移动时更新到保留区域,并在与政策共享的计算预算范围内执行。 机上执行保持控制及其保护独立于网络可用性和延迟性. 这些要求是相加的:只有在危险估计值为当前时,范围才会扩大,而且保持当前情况会增加控制循环的计算。

blocks.en: We present a runtime shield that addresses these requirements alongside a pretrained policy, without changing its weights. At reset, a vision-language model (VLM) names the hazard, an open-vocabulary detector localizes it, and registered depth yields a three-dimensional ellipsoid. The barrier program guards five ellipsoids across the gripper, wrist, and forearm, and sparse optical flow transports the hazard ellipsoid’s center as the hazard moves, without re-detection or refitting. On a laptop processor with a CPU, an integrated GPU (iGPU), and a neural processing unit (NPU), the policy runs on the iGPU, the fastest device measured for it, while the millisecond-scale barrier and tracker stay on the CPU.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个运行时屏障,既要满足这些要求,又要执行预先训练的政策,而不改变其权重。 在重置时,一个视觉语言模型(VLM)将危险命名,一个开放的伏波探测器将其定位,注册深度产生一个三维椭圆形. 屏障方案保护着5个椭圆形横跨钳形、腕部和前臂,以及稀少的光学流动,随着危险移动,危险椭圆形的中心运输,而无需重新探测或重新布置。 在一个拥有CPU,集成GPU(iGPU),神经处理单元(NPU)的笔记本电脑处理器上,政策运行在iGPU上,这是为其测得的最快的设备,而毫秒级屏障和跟踪器则停留在CPU上.

blocks.en: The evaluation compares the complete system against the unshielded policy and runtime-filter baselines on the static-hazard SafeLIBERO benchmark [ 8 ] and a new moving-hazard benchmark. Collision captures protection, task success captures task performance, and safe-success captures both. Ablations isolate the effects of arm coverage, hazard estimation, tracking, and policy configuration, while edge measurements characterize the cost of running the shield alongside the policy.
blocks.zh: 评价将整个系统与未屏蔽政策和静态-危险安全LEVERO基准的运行时间过滤基线以及新的移动-危险基准进行比较。 碰撞捕捉保护,任务成功捕捉任务性能,安全成功捕捉两者. 缺失将臂部覆盖、危险估计、跟踪和政策配置的影响隔离开来,而边缘测量则将盾牌与政策一起运行的成本列为特征。

blocks.en: These requirements pose a single question: can a fixed VLA policy be protected from a task-irrelevant moving object beyond its end effector, with a hazard estimate that stays current, within an onboard compute budget? The contributions answer it along three axes: coverage, motion, and deployment:
blocks.zh: 这些要求提出了一个单一的问题:一个固定的甚高频政策能否在船上的计算预算范围内,保护与任务无关的移动对象不超出其终端效应器,而危险估计值应保持当前状态? 报告围绕以下三个方面作了答复:覆盖面、运动和部署:

blocks.en: 1. Coverage: multi-link runtime shielding for pretrained policies. Five guarded ellipsoids extend the end-effector barrier across the gripper, wrist, and forearm by adding one constraint per element to a single barrier program. Broader coverage reduces collisions under image-based perception without a significant task-success cost. 2. Motion: hazard transport without re-detection, and a moving-hazard benchmark. Sparse optical flow transports the hazard ellipsoid without refitting. A benchmark of six hazard-motion conditions tests protection: our shield reduces collisions from 65.62 % 65.62\% to 27.27 % 27.27\% and increases safe-success from 29.35 % 29.35\% to 50.43 % 50.43\% . 3. Deployment: heterogeneous edge characterization and mapping. The policy call is measured on the CPU, the iGPU, and the NPU, and the complete loop then runs under the latency-minimizing mapping: policy, detector, and hazard namer on the iGPU, barrier and tracker on the CPU. Every policy configuration is evaluated with the shield active, and the same mapping drives a physical SO-101 arm around a tracked moving hazard.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Safety filters for learned manipulation. Control barrier functions enforce forward invariance under their model assumptions by constraining a nominal controller through a quadratic program [ 6 , 7 ] ; robust variants incorporate bounded state-estimation error [ 10 ] . Recent systems impose related constraints on VLA policies by fitting a semantic barrier at reset [ 8 ] , grounding constraints from policy attention [ 9 ] , or enforcing them within the action decoder [ 11 , 12 ] . However, end-effector constraints leave the wrist and forearm unguarded as they move through the scene. Manipulator barrier filters guard the links with sphere models [ 13 , 14 ] , and Any-Body Guard addresses robot geometry in configuration space but uses a quasi-static scene representation [ 15 ] . We instead guard five ellipsoids spanning the gripper, wrist, and forearm against one motion-updated hazard ellipsoid.
blocks.zh: 安全过滤器 用于学习操作。 控制屏障功能通过四进制程序约束名义控制器,在模型假设下执行前向偏移[6,7];强变体包含有约束的状态估计错误[10]. 最近的制度通过在重设[8]时设置语义障碍,使政策注意力受到制约[9],或在行动解码器内加以执行[11、12],对《维也纳条约法公约》政策施加了相关的限制。 然而,末端效应约束使得手腕和前臂在穿过场景时没有防守. 操纵屏障过滤器守护与球体模型的联系[13,14],Any-Body Guard在配置空间中处理机器人几何,但使用准静态场景代表[15]. 我们保护5个椭圆形 横跨抓手、手腕和前臂的椭圆形

blocks.en: Perception and motion. A geometric safety filter is only as current as its hazard estimate. Open-vocabulary detection with registered depth can construct that estimate from images [ 16 ] , but motion can invalidate a reset-time fit. Per-step segmentation can relocate the centers of hazard ellipsoids fitted at reset [ 9 ] , and promptable video segmentation maintains object identity through streaming inference [ 17 ] ; both run a neural network at every update, sharing the edge platform’s compute budget with the policy. Sparse optical flow [ 18 ] instead transports the fitted ellipsoid, preserving its reset shape.
blocks.zh: 观与动. 几何安全滤波器的电流与其危险估计值相同。 具有注册深度的开放-vocabulary探测可以构造从图像中估计的[16],但运动可以使重置时间适应无效. 逐步分割可以迁移安装在重置[9]的危险椭圆中心, 快速的视频分割通过流推论维持对象身份[17]; 每一次更新时都运行一个神经网络, 用政策分享边缘平台的计算预算。 Sparse光学流[18]转而运输装配的椭圆形,保留其重置形状.

blocks.en: Safety training and runtime constraints. Fine-tuning on collision-free demonstrations encodes avoidance behavior in the policy weights and adds no online filtering cost [ 5 ] . Runtime shielding complements this learned behavior by accepting a newly designated hazard at execution time and imposing an explicit geometric constraint without updating the policy. The scope here is task-irrelevant hazards that should remain untouched; tasks requiring contact with the hazard call for constraints beyond a strict keep-out region.
blocks.zh: 安全培训和运行时间限制。 对无碰撞演示进行精细调整,将政策权重中的避免行为编码,不增加在线过滤成本[5]. 运行时屏蔽通过接受执行时新指定的危险和在不更新政策的情况下施加明确的几何限制来补充这种学到的行为. 这里的范围是与任务无关的危害,这些危害应保持不变;需要与危害接触的任务要求在严格戒备区域之外加以限制。

blocks.en: Edge deployment. Efficient VLA systems reduce backbone size, input tokens, or action-decoding cost [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] . For π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , which reuses an encoded vision–language prefix during iterative action generation [ 1 , 2 ] , work on iterative-head policies, adaptive multi-view pruning, quantization, and cross-accelerator characterization is particularly relevant [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] . Policy efficiency alone does not determine the performance of a shielded system: hazard estimation and filtering impose workloads at different cadences, and policy approximations alter the commands presented to the shield. The deployment question is therefore how to allocate shared compute while retaining protection and task performance. This work maps perception, tracking, filtering, and policy inference to heterogeneous edge hardware at their respective cadences, and the evaluation tests each policy configuration with runtime shielding active.
blocks.zh: 边际部署. 高效的VLA系统降低主干大小,输入符,或动作解码成本[19,20,21]. 对于在迭代动作生成[1,2]中重复使用编码的视觉-语言前缀的   0.5\pi_{0.5},关于迭代头政策、适应性多视图浏览、量化和跨加速器特性的工作特别相关[22,23,24]. 单靠政策效率不能决定屏蔽系统的性能:危险估计和过滤会给不同隐蔽层带来工作量,政策近似会改变提交给屏蔽层的命令. 因此,部署问题是如何分配共享计算,同时保留保护和任务执行。 这项工作将感知、跟踪、过滤和政策推论绘制成各异的边缘硬件,并用运行时屏蔽积极测试每个政策配置。

blocks.en: III System Design
blocks.zh: 三. 系统设计

blocks.en:
Our shield is a training-free runtime filter between a pretrained VLA policy and the robot. The shield acts only on the policy’s commanded end-effector motion, so it does not depend on the policy’s internal architecture. The evaluation uses the π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} flow-matching policy [ 1 , 2 ] , whose structure Sec. III-D exploits for edge execution.
Building on AEGIS [ 8 ] , we retain that system’s semantic hazard naming, open-vocabulary grounding, depth-derived ellipsoid, and ellipsoid-separation control-barrier formulation. This common interface carries three extensions: protection across the arm’s distal links, transport of the fitted barrier when the hazard moves, and execution of the complete loop on heterogeneous edge hardware. The policy returns a chunk of normalized end-effector commands; each command is filtered against the measured robot state immediately before execution. Perception and control exchange only the hazard ellipsoid, allowing motion updates without changing the barrier formulation ( Fig. 2 ).

blocks.en: An end-effector barrier leaves the swept volume of proximal links outside its modeled safe set. The design therefore instantiates 𝒞 \mathcal{C} with five guarded ellipsoids distributed over the gripper, wrist, and forearm. The elongated forearm link is represented by three overlapping ellipsoids that retain the link’s full cross-section and span its long axis; the remaining ellipsoids are derived directly from the links’ collision geometry. The elbow and upper arm carry no guarded ellipsoid.

blocks.en: Reset-time initialization The VLM names the hazard from the task instruction and external image, using a short list of candidate hazard phrases when applicable. An open-vocabulary detector grounds the phrase in each camera view, and the selected boxes crop the registered depth images. Workspace, outlier, and density filtering precede a minimum-volume enclosing ellipsoid (MVEE) fit. The selected detection fixes the object identity for the episode.

blocks.en: The tracker operates in the fixed external camera. At initialization, the fitted ellipsoid’s center is projected onto the image, and a regular grid of nearby pixels is retained only where the measured depth agrees with the center depth. These persistent points are propagated by Lucas–Kanade flow [ 18 ] . Forward–backward agreement and depth consistency retain points that continue to support the hazard, and the median displacement from each point’s seed position yields a robust image-plane translation without summing incremental center updates. The camera ray passing through the translated image center intersects the horizontal plane through p o 0 p_{\mathrm{o}}^{0} to obtain c ⁡ ( t ) c(t) , assuming the hazard maintains its reset height. Two gates reject an unsupported translation: a bound on the center displacement per measurement, and a threshold on the normalized correlation with the reset appearance. When either gate fires, the center is held at its last accepted position while a bounded template search looks for the hazard; a match re-seeds the tracker.

blocks.en:
Guarantee scope Under the standard assumptions of a fixed hazard, exact state and geometry, an initially safe state, and feasible continuous-time execution under the modeled dynamics, the barrier conditions in ( 2 ) preserve the modeled safe set 𝒮 = { ( x , z ) : h k ( x , z k ) ≥ 0 , ∀ k ∈ 𝒞 } \mathcal{S}=\{(x,z):h_{k}(x,z_{k})\geq 0,\ \forall k\in\mathcal{C}\} .
The deployed system relaxes these assumptions: geometry is estimated from RGB-D observations, commands are applied in sample-and-hold fashion, link motion is approximated through G k G_{k} , and the hazard pose is updated periodically from optical flow. Consequently, each control step certifies the barrier conditions with respect to the latest estimated hazard pose rather than providing a continuous-time invariance guarantee for the moving-hazard loop. In particular, motion between updates and discrete changes in the estimated hazard pose are not represented explicitly in ( 2 ). If the program becomes infeasible, the current implementation executes and logs the nominal action rather than invoking a certified fallback. We therefore treat collision reduction in the deployed system as an empirical result. Extending the shield with perception-error bounds, sampled-data barrier conditions, and an explicit hazard-velocity term would provide a path toward stronger guarantees under moving hazards.

blocks.en: III-D Edge-Aware Policy Execution
blocks.zh: III-D 边框策略执行

blocks.en: Each policy invocation encodes the current vision–language prefix once [ 1 , 2 ] , then repeatedly integrates the action expert’s flow-matching field. Attention is bidirectional within the prefix, but prefix tokens do not attend to action tokens, so the prefix keys and values are computed once per call and reused across integration steps. A new observation changes the prefix, so the cache does not carry over across calls. Each integration step attends to the cached prefix, so redundant prefix slots increase both the one-time encoding work and the repeated prefix-action attention, whereas reducing the number of integration steps acts directly on the repeated path.
blocks.zh: 每一次政策引用都会编码当前视觉-语言前缀一次[1,2],然后反复整合动作专家的流量匹配领域. 注意在前缀内是双向的,但前缀符号不注意动作符号,因此每呼叫一次前缀键和值会计算出来,并跨整合步骤重复使用. 新的观察会改变前缀,所以缓存不会跨调用. 每个集成步骤都关注缓存前缀,因此冗余前缀插槽既增加了一次性编码工作,也增加了重复前缀动作注意,而减少了集成步骤在重复路径上直接作用的次数.

blocks.en: Two changes trim the prefix, and a third shortens the integration loop, none of them touching the policy weights. First, the benchmark provides two camera views, while the serving configuration allocates a third, masked camera slot. Masking does not skip that slot’s image encoder or its 256 256 prefix positions, so the deployed configuration removes it before encoding. Second, the padded text budget falls from 200 200 to 64 64 tokens; the longest benchmark instruction uses 21 21 tokens. This prefix trimming reduces the prefix from 3 × 256 + 200 = 968 3\times 256+200=968 to 2 × 256 + 64 = 576 2\times 256+64=576 positions. Third, the integration steps fall from ten to five, and the resulting approximation is evaluated with the shield active.
blocks.zh: 两次更改修剪前缀,第三次缩短了集成循环,都没有触及政策权重. 首先,基准提供两个相机视图,而服务配置分配第三个蒙面相机插槽. Masking不会跳过该槽的图像编码器或其256 256 前缀位置,因此部署的配置在编码前将其删除. 第二,加法文本预算从200,200个降到64,64个;最长的基准指令使用21,21个符号. 此前缀修饰将前缀从3×256+200=968 3\times 256+200=968降至2×256+64=576 2\times 256+64=576位. 第三,集成步骤从10个降到5个,由此形成的近似值由屏蔽主动评价.

blocks.en: Workload size and cadence decide the mapping. The barrier program and the optical-flow update are millisecond-scale, issued at every nominal 50 50 ms control step and every fifth step, respectively. Each is shorter than the overhead of an accelerator dispatch, so both run on the CPU. Dense policy inference, issued once per ten-action chunk, requires a dedicated accelerator such as an iGPU or an NPU.
blocks.zh: 工作负荷大小和考登斯决定了绘图. 屏障程序与光学流更新为毫秒级,分别以每标称50米控制步和每5步发布. 每个都比加速器调度的顶部短,所以都运行在CPU上. 每10个动作块发布一次的敏锐政策推论,需要iGPU或NPU等专用加速器.

blocks.en: The evaluation covers static and moving hazards in two simulated benchmarks that share the simulator, robot, policy interface, and evaluation metrics. Image-based configurations estimate hazard geometry from rendered RGB and registered simulator depth; they do not use the exact hazard pose or shape.

blocks.en: Static hazards. SafeLIBERO [ 8 ] extends the LIBERO suites [ 26 ] with a designated hazard object and a collision criterion for each scene. The evaluation comprises 32 32 scenes: four suites × \times two hazard levels × \times four tasks. The static benchmark runs every scene, with 1,600 1{,}600 episodes per configuration. It compares our shield with the unshielded policy and with two runtime safety methods, AEGIS and OSCBF. Two coverage variants, end-effector-only and multi-link, share one perception pipeline and controller.

blocks.en: Moving hazards. A new moving-hazard benchmark reuses these scenes and metrics, with a commanded hazard trajectory defined over the episode. Each moving configuration runs 624 624 episodes per condition, with 48 48 initial states across 13 13 scenes. The orbit uses a separate set of 13 13 scenes on which a 25 25 mm orbit is feasible; nine of them are shared with the other conditions. The six conditions are a stationary hazard, a circular orbit of 25 25 mm radius, a recurrent 300 300 mm shuttle, and one-way escape trajectories of 50 50 , 150 150 , and 300 300 mm that hold at their endpoints. All moving trajectories use a commanded speed of 50 50 mm/s. Each episode records the hazard’s true pose, commanded pose, and per-camera visibility at every step.
blocks.zh: 移动危险。 一个新的移动危险基准可以重新使用这些场景和度量衡,并对该场景设定一个指令性危险轨迹。 每个移动配置每个条件共运行624,624集,共有48个初始状态跨越13个场景. 轨道使用一套单独的13个场景,其中25个25毫米轨道是可行的;其中9个场景与其他条件共用. 6个条件为定点隐患,圆形轨道半径25 25 毫米,常态300 300 毫米穿梭,单向逃逸轨距50 150 和 300 300 毫米,在它们的端点停留. 所有移动轨迹都使用50毫米/秒的指令速度. 每集记录危险的真实姿势,指挥姿势,以及每部相机的能见度。

blocks.en: Reported mean rates average the six hazard-motion conditions. The repository baselines run all six conditions with the same episode keys ( Sec. V ). The ablations ( Sec. VI ) and the policy-configuration comparison ( Sec. V-B ) use the 300 300 mm escape condition, whose reset-to-final displacement is the largest, so a stale hazard estimate loses the most over the episode. Every simulated configuration uses the public π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} LIBERO checkpoint ( pi05_libero ) [ 1 ] . It runs in its released serving configuration with three camera slots, 200 200 text tokens, and ten integration steps. Edge timing and energy use the reduced configuration of Sec. III-D , whose effect on outcomes Sec. V-B is measured with the shield active.
blocks.zh: 所报告的6种危险移动条件的平均平均平均平均比率。 寄存器基线运行所有6个条件,有相同的插曲键(sec.V.). 爆破(Sec.VI)和政策配置对比(Sec.V-B)使用300毫米的逃逸状态,其重置至最终的离散量最大,因此一个呆滞的危险估计在剧集中损失最多. 每个模拟配置都使用公众 \\ 0. 5\\ 5} LIBERO 检查站( pi05_ Libero ) [1]. 它运行在其已发布的服务配置中,有三个相机插槽,200个文本符,以及十个集成步骤. 边缘定时和能量使用Sec. III-D的减速配置,其对结果Sec. V-B的影响用盾牌活性来测量.

blocks.en: Metrics. Safety is measured through collision rate and reported alongside task success and safe-success, defined as task completion without collision. For comparability with prior work, the evaluation adopts the SafeLIBERO displacement-based collision criterion of the released AEGIS benchmark code [ 8 ] , written collision throughout: an episode is flagged when the sum of absolute hazard position differences along the three axes exceeds 1 1 mm at any control step in MuJoCo. Displacement is measured from the initial hazard position in static scenes and from the latest commanded position in moving scenes, excluding scripted motion from the latter. The criterion records a disturbance of the hazard, which need not involve robot–hazard contact, so every episode also records MuJoCo robot–hazard contacts. Across the six hazard-motion conditions, 82.05 % 82.05\% of the unshielded policy’s flagged episodes carry a recorded contact, against 48.29 % 48.29\% under our shield: shielding removes contact episodes before it removes light disturbances. Rates on this stricter endpoint are therefore reported alongside the displacement endpoint ( Sec. V-A ).
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 安全性通过碰撞率衡量,并报告与任务成功和安全性成功同时进行,被定义为任务完成而不发生碰撞。 为了与以往工作的可比性,评价采用了SafeLIBERO基于AEGIS基准代码[8]的碰撞标准,即整个书面碰撞:当MuJoCo的任何控制步骤上,三轴沿线绝对危险位置差异的总和超过1毫米时,标出一集。 从静态场景中最初的危险位置和移动场景中最新指挥的位置来衡量流离失所情况,不包括后者的脚本运动。 标准记录了危害的扰动,不需要涉及机器人-危险接触,因此每集也记录MujoCo机器人-危险接触. 在6个危险运动条件下,82.05%的无屏蔽政策事件有记录的接触,而在我们的屏蔽下有48.29 % 的接触:屏蔽在清除光扰之前消除接触事件。 因此,在迁移终点(V-A.Sec.)的同时,报告这一更严格的终点的比率。

blocks.en: For the static benchmark, a replay of the recorded actions of the unshielded, coverage-variant, and complete-system configurations recovers peak hazard displacement and recomputes collision at 10 10 mm to assess sensitivity to collision severity.
blocks.zh: 对于静态基准,对未屏蔽的,覆盖变异的,和完整的系统配置所记录的动作进行重播,恢复峰值危险位移,并将碰撞重计为10毫米,以评估对碰撞严重程度的敏感性.

blocks.en: Implementation The simulated robot is the Franka Panda of the LIBERO suites in MuJoCo. The hazard namer is Qwen3-VL, and the detector is Grounding DINO [ 16 ] , prompted with the benchmark’s original caption, an oracle-corrected caption, or the VLM-generated name used in deployment. A fixed scale factor converts the policy’s normalized delta-pose actions into the end-effector twists the program uses, and converts the filtered twist back before execution. The barrier program ( 2 ) is solved with OSQP through CVXPY, weighting the twist deviation by W = I 6 / 25 W=I_{6}/25 and each guarded ellipsoid’s auxiliary rate by W z = I 3 W_{z}=I_{3} .
blocks.zh: 执行情况 模拟机器人是MujoCo的LIBERO套房的Franka Panda. 危险命名器为 Qune3- VL, 探测器为 Grounding DINO [ 16], 由基准的原始标题、 甲骨文校正标题 或部署时使用的 VLM 生成的名称 。 一个固定的尺度因子将策略的常态化的delta-pose动作转换为最终效果器扭曲程序使用,并在执行前将过滤过的扭矩转换回. 屏障程序(2)由OSQP通过CVXPY解决,以W = I 6 / 25 W = I = 6 }/ 25 和每个守护椭圆的辅助速率由W z = I 3 W_{z}=I = 3 = = 3 = 计算扭矩偏差.

blocks.en: Baseline implementations AEGIS [ 8 ] and OSCBF [ 13 ] run from the authors’ public code, integrated with the same policy, simulator, and benchmark episodes. AEGIS retains its end-effector barrier and two-view geometry fitted at reset, with its GLM-4.5V hazard namer replaced by Qwen3-VL. OSCBF retains torque-level filtering and its robot-sphere model, configured to match the simulated robot’s dynamics and torque limits, and takes hazard geometry and motion from our original caption perception pipeline. The robot envelopes therefore differ across methods. OSCBF keeps its published spheres and gains without tuning; its spheres end short of the open fingertips, whereas the AEGIS hand ellipsoid and ours enclose the gripper with margin.
blocks.zh: AEGIS[8]和OSCBF[13]的基线执行来自作者的公共代码,与同样的政策、模拟和基准事件相结合。 AEGIS保留了其端效屏障和重置时安装的双视几何,其GLM-4.5V危险命名器被Qune3-VL取代. OSCBF保留了扭矩级滤波器及其机器人圈模型,其配置符合模拟机器人的动力学和扭矩极限,并从我们最初的字幕感知管道中取出危险几何和运动。 因此,机器人信封的方法各不相同。 OSCBF保持其公布的球体和增益而不调和;其球体末端没有张开的指尖,而AEGIS手椭圆形和我们的球体则带有边角。

blocks.en: Statistical comparisons. All configurations run the same episodes with the same policy sampling seed, so comparisons are paired. Episodes from a single scene are correlated, so per-episode differences are averaged within each scene ( 13 13 moving, 32 32 static) and these scene averages serve as the samples; a mean over conditions exchanges the two configurations of a scene jointly in every condition that contains it, across the 17 17 scenes the six conditions span. A difference is significant when a paired permutation test across the scene averages yields p < 0.05 p<0.05 after Holm–Bonferroni correction [ 27 ] for the differences claimed in the same sentence. Two configurations are equivalent when the 90 % 90\% confidence interval of their difference lies within ± 3 \pm 3 percentage points, a margin set before the experiments.
blocks.zh: 统计比较。 所有配置都以相同的策略采样种子运行相同的片段,因此比较是成对的. 单一场景的片段是相互关联的,因此每个场景内部的每集差异平均(13 13动,32 32静态),这些场景平均值作为样本;在条件上,一个平均值在每一个包含该场景的状态下,在17个17个场景中,一个场景的两个配置共同交换,六个条件跨度. 如果在Holm-Bonferroni更正后,在现场进行对接的演化测试,平均结果为p < 0.05 p < 0.05,则差异是显著的。 当其差异的90% 90 =% 的置信间隔在 ± 3\pm 3 个百分点内时,两个配置是等效的,这是实验前设定的比值.

blocks.en: Timing and energy. The control loop targets 20 20 Hz. After warmup, filter latency is measured per control step and policy latency per chunk invocation; the median and the 99 99 th percentile (p50 and p99) are reported at these respective cadences. Policy-configuration comparisons run on the development platform, where call times are medians of within-episode percentiles; edge timing is measured on a Dell XPS 14 with an Intel Core Ultra X7 358H (Panther Lake), an iGPU, and an NPU. Energy and average power are read from the system-scope RAPL psys counter, a platform total with no per-device attribution, and are reported per isolated invocation above the 14.5 14.5 W idle power.
blocks.zh: 时机与能量. 控制循环目标为20赫兹。 温度升温后,每个控制步骤都测得滤波延迟度,每块引用时都测得政策延迟度;中间值和99 99 百分位数(p50和p99)分别报告在这些节点上。 政策配置比较运行在开发平台上,其中调用时间是集成百分位数的中位数;边缘计时在Dell XPS 14上用Intel Core Ul7 358H(Panther Lake),iGPU,和NPU测量. 能量和平均功率从系统范围RAPL psys计数器读取,这个平台总共没有每台设备的归属,并报告在14.5 14.5W闲置功率以上的个别引用.

blocks.en: All reported rates are computed in simulation. The physical SO-101 evaluation in Sec. V-B reports episode counts instead, with an external Intel RealSense D455 feeding both the policy and the shield. Each episode is scored by observation: a success when the object reaches its target, and a contact when the arm touches the hazard.
blocks.zh: 所有报告的比率都是在模拟中计算的。 Sec. V-B的物理SO-101评价报告插曲倒数,外置的Intel RealSense D455同时喂食政策和盾牌. 每集通过观察得分:在物体到达目标时成功,手臂触碰危险时接触.

blocks.en: V Evaluation
blocks.zh: 五 评价

blocks.en: This section first compares safety and task performance across static and moving hazards, then evaluates edge execution and policy optimizations with the shield active. AEGIS and OSCBF are external reference points that keep their own robot envelopes and gains, so this comparison establishes practical standing.
blocks.zh: 本节首先比较安全性和任务性能跨越静态和移动的危害,然后用主动屏蔽来评价边缘执行和政策优化. AEGIS和OSCBF是保持自己机器人信封和收益的外部参考点,因此这一比较确立了实用的地位.

blocks.en: V-A Safety and Task Performance
blocks.zh: V-A 安全和任务业绩

blocks.en: Our shield reduces collisions and increases the rate of safe task completion around moving hazards. Collision falls from 65.62 % 65.62\% to 27.27 % 27.27\% and safe-success rises from 29.35 % 29.35\% to 50.43 % 50.43\% ( Table I a); task success, 62.93 % 62.93\% unshielded and 61.38 % 61.38\% with the shield, shows neither a significant change nor equivalence within the ± 3 \pm 3 percentage-point margin. Against AEGIS, our shield collides significantly less often, in 27.27 % 27.27\% of episodes compared to 35.74 % 35.74\% , while its safe-success rate of 50.43 % 50.43\% , compared to 44.90 % 44.90\% , is not significantly higher.
blocks.zh: 我们的盾牌可以减少碰撞,提高围绕移动危险的安全任务完成率。 碰撞率从65.62 % 65.62 %降至27.27 % 27.27 %,安全成功率从29.35% 29.35 %增至50.43 % 50.43 % (表一a);任务成功率62.93%,无屏蔽度62.93%,带屏蔽度61.38%,在±3\pm 3个百分点的比值内既未显示重大变化,也未显示等值. 与AEGIS相比,我们的盾牌碰撞次数少得多,在27.27%的事故中,相较于35.74%的35.74%的事故中,其安全成功率为50.43 %的事故中,相较于44.90%的事故中,安全成功率为44.90%的事故中,没有明显提高。

blocks.en: OSCBF also reduces collisions relative to the unshielded policy, but exceeds our shield’s collision rate by 8.2 8.2 to 36.7 36.7 percentage points in all six conditions. With the original-caption perception, OSCBF collides in 48.96 % 48.96\% of episodes and reaches 41.88 % 41.88\% safe-success, both significantly worse than ours; its task success of 65.17 % 65.17\% , compared to 61.38 % 61.38\% , shows neither a significant difference nor equivalence. The OSCBF gap does not show that torque-level filtering protects less than action-level filtering, because the robot envelopes differ. With the hazard enclosed in a bounding sphere instead of the fitted ellipsoid, OSCBF collides in 25.80 % 25.80\% of 300 300 mm escape episodes, and none of its three rates differ significantly from those of the complete system.
blocks.zh: OSCBF还比无屏蔽政策减少了碰撞,但在所有六个条件下都比我们的屏蔽碰撞率高出8.2至36.7 36.7个百分点. 在最初的封装感下,OSCBF在48.96%的事故中碰撞了48.96%的事故,并达到了41.88%的41.88%的安全成功率,两者都比我们大为糟糕;它的任务成功率为65.17%的65.17%,而61.38%的61.38%没有显示出显著的差别或等效性。 OSCBF漏洞并不显示矩位滤波保护小于动作级滤波,因为机器人信封不同. 在300毫米越狱事件中,OSCBF碰撞率在25.80%25.80%,其三种犯罪率都没有与整个系统明显不同。

blocks.en: Counting only episodes with a recorded robot–hazard contact lowers every rate and leaves the ranking of the four systems unchanged: across the six conditions, collision is 53.85 % 53.85\% unshielded, 31.86 % 31.86\% for OSCBF, 23.61 % 23.61\% for AEGIS, and 13.17 % 13.17\% for our shield.
blocks.zh: 只用一个记录的机器人-危险接触来计数会降低每个速率,使这四个系统的排名保持不变:在6个条件中,碰撞率为53.85%、53.85%、31.86 %、OSCBF为31.86 %、23.61%、AEGIS为23.61%、13.17%、13.17 % 。

blocks.en: On static SafeLIBERO, our shield collides in 27.00 % 27.00\% of episodes, compared to 30.75 % 30.75\% for AEGIS. The multi-link configurations have the highest observed safe-success ( Table I b). On this still hazard, optical-flow transport adds no measured benefit: the multi-link configuration with a frozen hazard estimate collides in 25.19 % 25.19\% of episodes, compared to 27.00 % 27.00\% for the complete system. OSCBF collides in 66.88 % 66.88\% of static episodes ( Table I b).

blocks.zh: 部署

blocks.en: The barrier and the optical-flow tracker run on the CPU at their respective step cadences; the policy, the detector, and the hazard namer run on the iGPU, with the latter two running only at reset ( Table II ). A barrier step costs 0.0189 0.0189 J, and an optical-flow update costs 0.132 0.132 J, compared to 7.86 7.86 J for a policy call. Safety under policy optimization For static hazards, the reduced configuration of Sec. III-D leaves task success and safe-success equivalent. At the same time, collision rises by 1.75 1.75 percentage points. With the filter active, the same reduction lowers the single-client call time by 32.7 % 32.7\% at p50.
On the 300 300 mm escape condition, the same reduction leaves shielded collision at 22.92 % 22.92\% against 22.44 % 22.44\% , so the shield’s collision reduction is unaffected by the policy configuration. Task success falls by 4.17 4.17 percentage points and safe-success by 3.53 3.53 percentage points, both significant. Without the shield, the same reduction changes neither rate significantly.
The barrier corrects about a quarter of control steps in every configuration. That fraction is insensitive to the deviation threshold used to define a correction, so barrier activity is governed by geometry rather than by the policy configuration.

政策优化下的安全问题 对于静态危害,Sec. III-D的配置减少,使得任务成功,安全成功等效. 同时,碰撞上升1.751.75个百分点. 随着滤波器的运行,同样的还原将单客户呼叫时间在p50时降低了32.7%的32.7\%.
在300毫米的逃生条件下,同样的减速叶的屏蔽碰撞在22.92% 22.92\%对22.44% 22.44\%,因此屏蔽的减速碰撞不受政策配置的影响. 任务成功率下降4.174.17个百分点,安全成功率下降3.533.53个百分点,两者都相当显著。 没有盾牌,同样的还原率也没有显著变化.
屏障修正了每个配置中大约四分之一的控制步骤. 该分数对用于定义校正的偏移阈值不敏感,因此障碍活动受几何而非政策配置的制约.

Physical deployment We also deploy the shield on an SO-101 arm across four tabletop placement tasks, with instructions such as place the white sugar cube in the cup , with a bottle or a box obstructing the arm’s path. A fixed π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} policy provides the nominal actions. An external Intel RealSense D455 supplies aligned RGB-D observations for fitting the hazard ellipsoid at reset and the image stream on which optical flow transports it; its RGB stream and a wrist-mounted camera provide the policy observations.
On the same edge platform and device mapping as in Table II , the transported ellipsoid follows the hazard as it is carried across the arm’s path ( Fig. 3 ). Across the four tasks, four episodes each, the arm touched the hazard in 3 3 of 16 16 shielded episodes and in 11 11 of 16 16 unshielded ones; it completed the placement in 11 11 shielded episodes and in 13 13 unshielded ones. The hardware episode budget is small, and the hazard is hand-carried, so these counts are reported without the paired tests of Sec. V-A .

blocks.en: VI Ablations and Analysis
blocks.zh: 六. 分析和分析

blocks.en: This section examines the protection and task costs of multi-link coverage, losses due to perception and tracking, and the placement accuracy and update frequency required to maintain protection. Each study varies one policy factor, with the perception and controller otherwise fixed, so these are the paper’s controlled comparisons along the coverage and motion axes.
blocks.zh: 本节审查多链路覆盖的保护和任务成本,因感知和跟踪造成的损失,以及维持保护所需的放置精度和更新频率. 每项研究都有一个不同的政策因素,认识和控制器在其他方面是固定的,因此,这些是纸张在覆盖和运动轴上的可控比较。

blocks.en: VI-A Multi-Link Protection and Its Task Cost
blocks.zh: VI-A 多链接保护及其任务成本

blocks.en: With perception and the controller held fixed, guarding the wrist and forearm in addition to the end effector reduces static collision from 31.31 % 31.31\% to 25.19 % 25.19\% ( Table I b). Neither task success ( 65.62 % 65.62\% to 61.62 % 61.62\% ) nor safe-success ( 51.56 % 51.56\% to 52.88 % 52.88\% ) changes significantly. Relative to unshielded execution, safe failures (episodes that avoid the hazard but do not complete the task) rise from 1.50 % 1.50\% to 21.94 % 21.94\% of episodes under multi-link coverage. With exact hazard geometry and motion, which is not deployable, the same coverage change reduces collision from 21.94 % 21.94\% under end-effector coverage to 14.44 % 14.44\% .
blocks.zh: 在感知和控制器固定的情况下,除终端效应器外,保护手腕和前臂将静态碰撞率从31.31%降至25.19%(表一b)。 任务成功率(65.62% 65.62 %至61.62% 61.62 %)或安全成功率(51.56% 51.56 %至52.88% 52.88 %)都没有重大变化。 相对于未屏蔽的处决,安全故障(避免危险但不能完成任务的异位素)从1.50%1.50%增加到21.94%21.94%的多链接覆盖下的事件. 由于精确的危险几何和运动是不可部署的,同样的覆盖变化将碰撞率从21.94%的21.94%降至14.44 %的14.44 %。

blocks.en: Shielding also reduces collision severity: unshielded episodes displace the hazard by 147.7 147.7 mm at the median, and more than nine in ten exceed 10 10 mm, whereas the disturbances surviving multi-link coverage fall to 32.5 32.5 mm. When a collision requires 10 10 mm of displacement instead of 1 1 mm, multi-link coverage retains 83.7 % 83.7\% of its advantage over end-effector coverage ( 5.12 5.12 versus 6.12 6.12 percentage points), a benefit concentrated at displacements below 50 50 mm.
blocks.zh: 屏蔽还降低了碰撞严重性:未屏蔽的事故在中位值上使危险取代147.7 147.7毫米,十分之九以上超过10 10毫米,而扰动幸存的多链路覆盖降至32.5 32.5毫米。 当碰撞需要10 10 毫米而不是1 1 毫米时,多链路覆盖保留了83.7%的优势,而不是终端效应覆盖(5.12 5.12比6.12 6.12个百分点),这一惠益集中在50 毫米以下的转移。

blocks.en: VI-B Hazard Estimation and Tracking Failures
blocks.zh: 六-B 危险估计和追踪失败

blocks.en: Broader coverage is worth only as much as the placement of the hazard ellipsoid it works against. Exact hazard geometry and motion are therefore replaced by staged perception to locate where protection is lost. On the 300 300 mm escape condition, collision falls from 30.29 % 30.29\% with a hazard estimate frozen at reset to 18.43 % 18.43\% with exact geometry and true motion, which is not deployable ( Table III ). Replacing the exact geometry with the detector geometry while retaining true motion raises the collision rate to 20.19 % 20.19\% . At the same time, task success and safe-success are both higher, so exact geometry and motion do not upper-bound task outcomes. Replacing true motion with optical flow raises collision to 22.44 % 22.44\% and reduces task success from 68.59 % 68.59\% to 64.74 % 64.74\% . Optical flow accounts for the remaining measured loss and still improves every rate over the frozen-hazard estimate. Image-based perception therefore retains most of the protection available with exact geometry and motion.
blocks.zh: 扩大的覆盖范围只相当于它所反对的危险椭圆的放置。 因此,精确的危险几何和运动被分阶段的感知所取代,以找到失去保护的地方。 在300毫米的逃逸条件下,碰撞率从30.29%30.29%下降到18.43%18.43%18.43%,精确几何和真实运动是不可部署的(表三)。 用探测器几何取代精确的几何,同时保留真正的运动,将碰撞率提高到20.19% 20.19%。 同时,任务成功和安全成功率都较高,因此精确的几何学和运动性并不能达到更高的任务结果. 用光学流取代真正的运动将碰撞率提高到22.44 % 22.44 % ,并将任务成功率从68.59% 68.59 % 降低到64.74% 64.74 % 。 光学流占了所测量的剩余损失,并且仍然比冰冻危害估计值提高了每个速率。 因此,基于图像的感知保留了大部分有精确几何和运动的可用保护.

blocks.en: Replacing the oracle-corrected caption with the VLM-generated name leaves the aggregate collision unchanged at 22.44 % 22.44\% , with negligible changes in task success and safe-success. This parity conceals a failure on the object with the weakest grounding. In six of 624 624 episodes, the same plausible but incorrect phrase causes the filter guard to assign a different object, a systematic failure that aggregate rates hide.
blocks.zh: 用 VLM 生成的名称取代甲骨文校正标题, 总碰撞率不变,为22.44 % 22.44% ,任务成功和安全成功的变化可忽略不计。 这种等价性以最弱的地基掩盖了物体上的失败. 在624 624集中的6集中,同一个可能但错误的短语导致过滤器守护器指定了不同的对象,这种系统故障会隐藏总率.

blocks.en: Repeated detection incurs both computation and association costs. One detector call on the edge platform costs about 148 × 148\times the latency and 149 × 149\times the energy of an optical-flow update ( Table II ). Refits are accepted only within 50 50 mm of the last accepted position; this gate rejects correct proposals after larger motion and can retain a wrong anchor. The fixed-cadence variant therefore collides as often as a hazard estimate frozen at reset ( Table III ), accepting at least one refresh in only 184 184 of 624 624 episodes. On the stationary condition, repeated refitting raises collision by 8.81 8.81 percentage points over the frozen estimate: the frame-to-frame shape variation that a single reset fit avoids. Optical flow instead transports the identity established at reset, updating the ellipsoid without re-detection or association.
blocks.zh: 重复检测既需要计算成本,也需要关联成本。 一台探测器在边缘平台的呼叫大约花费了148×148\时的潜伏度,149×149\时的光学流更新能量(表二). 只有在最后被接受的位置的50毫米范围内才接受调适;这个大门在更大的运动后拒绝正确的建议,可以保留错误的锚. 因此,固定空间的变体与重置时冻结的危险估计一样频繁碰撞(表三),在624,624个事件中,只有184,184个恢复了危险。 在固定状态下,反复重置使碰撞比冷冻估计高出8.818.81个百分点:一个单一重置能够避免的帧对帧形状变化. 光学流转则传输在重置时建立的身份,更新椭圆形而不进行再探测或结合.

blocks.en: VI-C Placement Accuracy and Update Frequency
blocks.zh: VI-C 定位精确度和更新频率

blocks.en:
Two sweeps test the placement accuracy and update frequency needed to maintain protection. Retained benefit is collision reduction relative to unshielded execution, normalized by the reduction at zero displacement. Both sweeps run on the static benchmark ( Fig. 4 (b)).
Translating only the ellipsoid retains 92.0 % 92.0\% and 72.6 % 72.6\% of its benefit at 25 25 and 50 50 mm; moving the hazard away from a frozen estimate retains 82.1 % 82.1\% and 27.6 % 27.6\% . The gap between the two widens from 9.9 9.9 to 45.0 45.0 percentage points across that interval, so a good reset fit does not replace transport during motion. The median fitted-center error on the static benchmark, 20.8 20.8 mm, is below the smallest nonzero offset tested.

两次扫射测试了维持保护所需的放置精度和更新频率. 与未屏蔽的处决相比,保留的好处是减少碰撞,通过零移位的减少而正常化。 两次扫射都按静态基准进行(图4(b))。

blocks.en: The cadence sweep uses 624 624 paired 300 300 mm escape episodes per configuration with the original caption, separate from the oracle-corrected-caption variants above ( Fig. 4 (a)). At strides 1 1 , 2 2 , 5 5 , 10 10 , and 20 20 , collision stays between 22.76 % 22.76\% and 24.84 % 24.84\% , strides 1 1 and 2 2 are equivalent to stride 5 5 , and neither task success nor safe-success differs significantly from stride 5 5 . True-motion transport stays lower at 21.47 % 21.47\% , and more frequent updates do not close this gap, because optical flow localizes the hazard with 48.2 48.2 to 49.7 49.7 mm of error at every stride, compared to 37.3 37.3 mm with true motion. Longer strides lose protection: collision rises to 28.37 % 28.37\% at stride 40 40 and 29.97 % 29.97\% at stride 80 80 , close to the frozen hazard estimate at 30.29 % 30.29\% .

blocks.en: VII Conclusion and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 七. 结论和未来方向

blocks.en: This work shows that runtime protection for pretrained VLA policies can be extended beyond the end effector, kept current around moving hazards, and executed on shared edge hardware without retraining the policy. Multi-link coverage improves protection across the arm, while sparse optical flow preserves most of the benefit lost when the hazard estimate is frozen. Both the barrier and tracker remain millisecond-scale workloads, making policy inference the dominant cost of the deployed system rather than shielding.
blocks.zh: 这项工作表明,对预先训练的VLA政策的运行时间保护可以扩展到终端效应器以外,在移动危险周围保持时速,并在共享的边缘硬件上执行,而不对政策进行再培训. 多链路覆盖可以改善整个臂部的保护,而光学流的稀少则保留了危险估计冻结时损失的大部分好处. 障碍物和跟踪器仍然是毫秒的工作量,使政策推断出部署系统的主导成本,而不是屏蔽成本。

blocks.en: The edge measurements also identify where that cost lies. Prefix trimming and fewer flow-matching integration steps substantially reduce policy latency, while NPU execution is still dominated by vision-language prefix encoding and cache construction. For this unbatched π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} workload, lower accelerator power does not translate to lower energy per call; reducing prefix-processing latency is therefore the more relevant optimization target.
blocks.zh: 边缘测量还确定了成本所在。 前缀修饰和较少的流量匹配集成步骤大大减少了政策延迟,而NPU执行仍然以视觉语言前缀编码和缓存构建为主. 对于这个没有争论的~~ 0.5\pi_{0.5} 工作量,较低的加速器功率不会转化为每个呼叫的能量更低;因此,减少前缀处理空闲性是更相关的优化目标.

blocks.en: A remaining challenge is tighter interaction between the policy and shield. The shield modifies commanded motion, but the fixed policy does not observe those corrections within its current action chunk, which can limit recovery when avoidance requires replanning. Feeding shielded state and corrective actions back into the policy, together with safe fallback behaviors, offers a path toward higher task completion and stronger protection under moving hazards. More broadly, the results demonstrate that motion-aware, multi-link shielding can provide a practical onboard safety layer around general-purpose manipulation policies.
blocks.zh: 剩下的一个挑战是加强政策和盾牌之间的互动。 盾牌修改了指令性运动,但固定政策没有在其目前的行动块内遵守这些修正,这可以限制在撤销需要重新规划时的恢复。 将屏蔽状态和纠正行动反馈到政策中,加上安全回落行为,为在移动危险下完成更高任务和加强保护提供了一条道路。 更广泛地说,这些结果表明,运动意识多链接屏蔽可围绕通用操纵政策提供实际的机上安全层。
